pages.title: Void Pearl
pages.text: Darkness and death-denial remnant. Strongest in low light. Dropped by Shulkers.

pages.title: Dormant and Latent
pages.text: $(l)Dormant$(): No need for air. Harmful effects wear off faster. Your hits inflict $(thing)Withering Decay$(). May deny a lethal hit.$(br2)$(l)Latent$(): Harmful effects wear off even faster. Denies lethal hits more reliably.

pages.title: Awakened, Ascended, Transcendent, Apex
pages.text: $(l)Awakened$(): In low light, nearby enemies get Wither and Weakness ($(thing)Hollow Dominion$()). Lethal-hit denial is no longer random.$(br2)$(l)Ascended$(): Darkness gives you speed and attack speed. Decayed enemies deal less damage.$(br2)$(l)Transcendent$(): Bigger aura that strips beneficial effects. Much stronger death denial.$(br2)$(l)Apex$(): Hardest to kill in darkness. Decayed enemies below a health threshold can be killed outright.
